description: Search the Artyfile catalog of licensable music — real, human-made recordings by real orchestras and musicians. Returns ranked tracks with prices; each result id is the productId create_checkout accepts. Results with licenseScope "master_only" are Cover Editions with NO sync licence — do not pick them for film/video/media projects.

genre.description: Optional genre filter, one of: Cinematic, Classical, Pop, Rock, Electronic, Ambient, Folk, Jazz, Lounge, World, Choral, Hip-Hop, Funk & Soul, Country

mood.description: Optional mood filter, one of: Uplifting, Happy, Energetic, Playful, Groovy, Epic, Dramatic, Suspenseful, Dark, Mysterious, Dreamy, Calm, Tender, Romantic, Reflective, Nostalgic, Melancholic, Solemn, Festive, Elegant

query.description: Use case, mood, genre or instrumentation, e.g. "epic cinematic trailer" or "calm piano for a documentary"

use_case.description: Optional use-case filter, one of: film, trailer, documentary, advertising, corporate, wedding, meditation, social, gaming, podcast, fashion, travel, sports, kids, christmas, party

name: search_tracks
